discoveredIssues.description: Direct URL navigation to /entities/:id/edit crashes with React hooks error ('Rendered more hooks than during the previous render'). EditEntityPage has early returns for isError/isLoading before useMemo/useCallback calls, violating rules of hooks. Navigation via Edit button works correctly.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Move useMemo/useCallback calls before the early returns, or restructure component to use conditional rendering inside the hook calls.
